records.description: Verification of zero lexical or semantic overlap between D_val and D_test.
records.findings: D_test contains 50 hand-crafted difficult examples; D_val contains 25 distinct examples. Direct intersection of text strings is 0.
records.proposed_fix: Maintain explicit assertion in all benchmark runners.

records.description: V1 batch dataset generator in core/dataset_generator.py.
records.findings: Static generation mixes 50% canonical, 20% boundary, 30% adversarial. Works as designed for V1, but lacks stage-based curriculum progression.
records.proposed_fix: Retain for V1 backward compatibility; implement dynamic curriculum scheduler for V2.1.

records.findings: Generates 100% boundary/hard-negative/contrastive examples without first ensuring canonical anchor stability. This causes lexical decision surface collapse on simpler classifiers.
records.root_cause: Premature boundary hardening without curriculum anchor foundation.
records.proposed_fix: Upgrade to accept curriculum stage context and enforce anchor ratio minimums.

records.findings: Currently performs Jaccard char-trigram dedup (threshold 0.70) and label validation, but lacks anchor coverage checks, conflicting-label detection, and provenance tracking.
records.root_cause: Filter only checks basic syntax and deduplication.
records.proposed_fix: Extend filter to validate curriculum composition, conflicting cross-class keywords, and provenance metadata.

records.findings: Flywheel works end-to-end with multi-objective promotion gate (F1 >= +0.010, slice tolerances >= -0.010), but immediately feeds 100% targeted boundary data into N+1 dataset.
records.root_cause: Single-step targeted augmentation without staged curriculum scheduling.
records.proposed_fix: Integrate curriculum scheduler, stage-aware retraining, and rich lineage telemetry.

records.findings: Evaluates Macro F1 lift (>= +0.010), boundary tolerance (>=-0.010), hard-negative tolerance (>=-0.010), and targeted confusion pair resolution.
records.proposed_fix: Maintain gate logic and add curriculum stage completion metrics.

records.findings: Supports fast sklearn TF-IDF + LogisticRegression and HuggingFace DistilBERT. Handles empty datasets and single-class edge cases gracefully.

records.description: Multi-slice metrics and confusion matrix in core/evaluation_engine.py.
records.findings: Computes Macro F1, weighted F1, precision, recall, boundary accuracy, hard-negative accuracy, adversarial accuracy, and confusion matrix.

records.description: Confusion matrix and weak-class diagnostic in core/error_analyzer.py.
records.findings: Correctly ranks weakest classes and bidirectional confusion pairs.

records.description: Database models in models.py and lineage tracking.
records.findings: DatasetVersion, TrainingRun, EvaluationRun, and OptimizationCycle capture full DAG lineage with parent_version_id and JSON snapshots.
records.proposed_fix: Add curriculum stage and provenance fields to DatasetVersion model.

records.description: Benchmark execution in core/benchmark_suite.py and scratch/run_benchmark_audit.py.
records.findings: Runs 5 seeds x 6 budgets with zero leakage. Accurately reports empirical Macro F1 without synthetic multiplier inflation.
records.proposed_fix: Extend suite to support 8-arm ablation matrix (Arms A through H).
Expose curriculum parameters and ablation data in API endpoints.

records.description: Web UI in index.html and app_connected.js.
records.findings: V2 tabs exist, but curriculum stage breakdowns, provenance badges, and live ablation comparisons need full wiring.
records.root_cause: Frontend created for early V2 prototype before V2.1 curriculum.
records.proposed_fix: Wire full V2.1 curriculum controls, provenance explorer, and ablation results in Phase 10.

records.findings: Dynamically checks PRAGMA table_info and adds missing columns automatically without data loss.
records.proposed_fix: Ensure new V2.1 columns (e.g., stage, provenance) are included in auto-migration.

records.description: datetime.datetime.utcnow() deprecation warnings in SQLAlchemy / optimization engine.
records.findings: Python 3.13 deprecates utcnow() in favor of datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).
records.proposed_fix: Update datetime calls to timezone-aware UTC.
